name: Mike McGraw
source:
Mike McGraw is Lone River's supervisor for the Parole and Probation service. A veteran of many conflicts and battles, he's seen and done it all. While he can be rather lewd at times and make certain off-the-cuff remarks, he makes sure the citizens of his community are safe and protected from those under his gaze.
